_comment: Project-scoped Notion + Lark MCP template. SECRET-FREE: each server loads credentials from macOS Keychain at process start. The installer initializes only a missing project .mcp.json and never overwrites a project-owned file.

args: eval "$("$HOME/bin/api_keys" export)" && export NOTION_TOKEN="$NOTION_API_KEY" && exec npx -y @notionhq/notion-mcp-server@2.4.1
eval "$("$HOME/bin/api_keys" export)" && exec npx -y @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp@0.5.1 mcp -a "$LARK_APP_ID" -s "$LARK_APP_SECRET" -d https://open.larksuite.com
